Hi! I’m Snehal— Creative Strategist, Copywriter & Brand Storyteller.

About me

Rooted in research. Crafted to connect.

With a triple-major degree in Media, Psychology, and Literature, I bring a multidisciplinary approach to storytelling, strategy, and marketing. My background spans journalism, copywriting, content strategy, and marketing, shaping the way I think about narratives—not just as words on a page, but as tools to inform, engage, and inspire action.

I write content that connects and converts, blending research-driven insights with creativity to craft stories that resonate. Whether it’s longform features for The Hindu’s Metro Plus, social media campaigns for brands, or marketing strategies designed for impact, my work is about clarity, connection, and culture.

Here are some highlights from my portfolio—projects that reflect my approach, where research meets creativity, and where strategy meets storytelling.

And like every strategist, I have a few essentials that fuel my process.

25+ books
ghostwritten and/or copyedited, across genres, industries, and perspectives.

for Metro Plus, the lifestyle supplement of The Hindu.
7 core brands

“Picture abhi baaki hai, mere dost.”

Every great story has that moment before the drama begins.

Before the music swells. Before the heroine makes her entry. Before the title flashes across the screen. And before Ting, there were many such chapters: Journalism. Marketing. Communications. Strategy. Ghostwriting...

Different worlds.
Different roles.
Different scenes.

At the time, they felt like separate shows. But looking back, they were all part of the same build-up because Ting was the first place where every one of those skills had to come alive at once.

And that is where our story begins.
